repair_rules.M2: evaluate_endedness keeps the sealed transaction and its validated served entry in view (txn/served). def _late_recheck(st, io, view):
    """V7 M2: NONSEALING transaction recheck after the LAST external callback, immediately before any ENDED return.
    No callback, no seal. A transaction that became unclean after the seal (e.g. a caught refused rebind or a
    post-seal census call inside a reader/deadline callback) or whose census view changed refreshes the reported view
    and fires E_CENSUS_TRANSACTION (HELD). Returns True only for an unchanged clean sealed transaction."""
    try:
        state, served = view['txn'], view['served']
        fresh = _census_view(state, served)
        clean = (state.sealed is True and state.active is False and state.poisoned is False
                 and state.retention_failed is False and type(state.reentries) is int and state.reentries == 0
                 and type(state.calls) is int and state.calls == 1 and type(state.served_n) is int
                 and state.served_n == 1 and type(state.refusal_n) is int and state.refusal_n == 0
                 and _exact(fresh, view['census']))
        view['census'] = fresh
    except Exception as exc:
        io.keep(exc)
        clean = False
    if not clean:
        st.fire('E_CENSUS_TRANSACTION', 'transaction unclean or changed after the last callback (nonsealing recheck)')
    return clean
